title: DC-area forecast: Chance of showers today then a good-looking Saturday
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Mostly cloudy today with scattered showers this afternoon. Humid highs mainly within a few degrees of 85.

What’s next? More typical August conditions through the weekend but fairly decent. Saturday's combined lower humidity and rain chances make it the better of the two days. Shower and storm chances return Sunday and Monday before drier weather Tuesday.

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: Cloudier and mid-80s for highs, though a bit humid. We'll see how thunderstorms progress toward our area during the afternoon.  | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Friday): Mainly cloudy skies should cap highs within a few degrees of 85. Rather humid with some scattered showers this afternoon. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Mostly cloudy as scattered showers remain possible in the evening. Just a slight chance of a lingering shower overnight. Lows range from the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Saturday): Skies turn partly to mostly sunny with highs within a few degrees of 85. We may get a slight humidity reprieve midday if dew points can get down into the mid-60s. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Showers or even a storm are possible after midnight, mainly in the predawn hours. Skies are mostly cloudy otherwise. Lows should bottom out within a few degrees of 70. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Maybe a few more clouds than Saturday with highs in the low to mid-80s. Humidity rises and so do shower and storm chances — especially mid-afternoon onward. If skies end up clearer than currently expected and we stay drier, highs nearer 90 are possible. Confidence: Low-Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Sunday night: Some showers and storms may continue just past midnight. Otherwise, skies are mostly cloudy. Muggy lows near 70 to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium

A chance of a few showers or storms may persist into Monday. Highs aim for the mid-80s to around 90. Thunderstorms shouldn't pop until the mid-afternoon to mid-evening timeframe. Confidence: Medium

Looking sunnier Tuesday as highs may again aim for the mid-80s to near 90. It should be a little less humid with somewhat limited storm chances, as it looks now. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for August 14

Relentless heat in 1980 extended a record 21-day streak of 90-degree highs, part of one of the hottest summers on record.
